name: input-group
description: A source-owned shadcn-style InputGroup for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: InputGroup/InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupText/InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea replicate upstream's bordered-field-with-addons composition, including the has-[>[data-align=block-start/end]]:flex-col rule that switches the container to a column layout around a stacked textarea + addon (an initial pass dropped this, which visually broke into a one-character-wide textarea column -- caught by a live dx-serve check, not by compile-clean checks, and fixed). InputGroupButton reuses the installed Button's own ButtonVariant/ButtonSize enums directly (Ghost/Xs default) instead of a duplicate parallel size scale. InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea author their own flush classes rather than composing Input/Textarea, since adico_lib::cn has no Tailwind-merge equivalent to reliably override those components' fixed classes. InputGroupAddon omits upstream's click-to-focus-sibling-input JavaScript (a non-essential UX nicety); see the module doc comment.
